title: SETH-based Gaussian kernel density estimation hardness across dimension and scale regimes

standard_prerequisites.name: SETH-based cited closest-pair hardness, standard Schur polynomial identities and Cauchy-Binet
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Author exact cited hardness statements and complete bibliography retained; all counting-matrix and kernel-specific local proofs included.

core_obligations: Bound the counting-matrix inverse for Gaussian kernels by its Vandermonde structure.
Apply the parameter-sensitive BCP-to-KDE reduction in both stated dimension regimes.
difficulty_reason: Analyzes the inverse of a Gaussian counting matrix via its Vandermonde structure and combines that bound with a bichromatic-closest-pair reduction. The high-dimensional small-scale and low-dimensional precision regimes are retained together, including every SETH assumption and parameter inequality.

dedup.scope: Root checked complete legacy, aliases, preparation and both active production lines for this exclusive DOI without neighbors. Three records count the distinct Gaussian, t-Student and rational-quadratic kernel hardness mechanisms. Parameter regimes within each theorem are bundled; Schur, counting-matrix and BCP supporting results are uncounted.
